description: This file implements a Bootstrap datepicker plugin, providing UI components for date selection, including native detection, calendar rendering, navigation, and keyboard controls.

classes.name: DatePicker
classes.description: Main class implementing the datepicker widget, handling initialization, rendering, user interaction, and date management.

methods.name: detectNative
methods.description: Detects if the browser supports native date input types and activates it if possible.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the datepicker UI components, including navigation and calendar grid.

methods.name: nav
methods.description: Creates navigation subcomponents for months and years.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Updates the display of month or year with visual effects.

methods.name: selectMonth
methods.description: Renders the calendar days for a specific month.

methods.name: selectDate
methods.description: Sets the selected date and updates the calendar view.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the input field with the selected date.

methods.name: keyHandler
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the datepicker.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a RFC 3339 date string.

methods.name: ahead
methods.description: Moves the current selection ahead by months and days.

methods.name: proxy
methods.description: Binds methods to the DatePicker instance for event handling.

methods.name: daysBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates.

methods.name: findClosest
methods.description: Finds the closest date matching a specific day of the week.

methods.name: rangeStart
methods.description: Calculates the start date for the calendar view.

methods.name: rangeEnd
methods.description: Calculates the end date for the calendar view.
